title: report
description: A page of sections, each a heading over parts: Markdown text, code, commands at a terminal, tables, images, notes, numbers, progress, steps, checklists, what changes, options, facts, diffs, file trees, links, review findings, folded parts, decisions, fields, timelines, bars, questions, records with long text, keys, tabs, scripts, diagrams, or HTML for what they cannot say.

eyebrow.description: A short line above the title, such as the kind of page and its date

lead.description: A sentence or two under the title that sums the page up

sections.description: Subsections drawn after the section's parts, each a heading over parts, one level only
